cond_0001.intro: Reporting to the Process Engineering Supervisor, the Process Engineering Technician performs technical tests and experiments for process engineering.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
What a typical day looks like:
Work in ISO level 8 cleanroom environment.
Perform set-up of processing equipment.
Monitor, audit and provide guidance to line operators and maintenance personnel
Process test runs and prepare records, charts, and graphs of results for presentation to engineering to identify yield problems or test new products.
Provide technical assistance to process development and engineering personnel.
Line change configuration.
Perform and assist with corrective maintenance and yield improvement activities
Follows escalation procedures.
Work with cross functional teams interfacing with different departments like Operations, Quality
Troubleshoot manufacturing process issues in a timely manner.
Comfortable working in a high-pressure, dynamic environment.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
6+ Years of related experience supporting automated production equipment.
Setup, operation and maintenance of industrial equipment
Electro-Mechanical Knowledge, Electrical schematics, Mechanical drawing and dimensional annotation comprehension.
Ability to understand and interface with various Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs)
Ability to work with complex industrial mechanical assembly's in an automated environment.
Ability to troubleshoot network and serial communications in equipment
Preferred Requirements
Associate's Degree in related field, technical training or equivalent education and training. Electrical, Mechatronic, Automation, Mechanical, or Industrial concentration is preferred.
Experience in technical writing to support change control and quality/compliance activities
Experience working in a regulated industry (Medical, Pharmaceutical, Aerospace, or Automotive), with compliance to FDA, NHTSA, FTC, ISO or other regulatory requirements.

Reporting to the Process Engineering Supervisor, the Process Engineering Technician performs technical tests and experiments for process engineering. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with process engineering and equipment support.
cond_0374.responsibilities:
What a typical day looks like:
Work in ISO level 8 cleanroom environment.
Perform set-up of processing equipment.
Monitor, audit and provide guidance to line operators and maintenance personnel.
Process test runs and prepare records, charts, and graphs of results for presentation to engineering to identify yield problems or test new products.
Provide technical assistance to process development and engineering personnel.
Line change configuration.
Perform and assist with corrective maintenance and yield improvement activities.
Follows escalation procedures.
Work with cross functional teams interfacing with different departments like Operations, Quality.
Troubleshoot manufacturing process issues in a timely manner.
Comfortable working in a high-pressure, dynamic environment.
cond_0374.requirements:
Associate's Degree in related field, technical training or equivalent education and training. Electrical, Mechatronic, Automation, Mechanical, or Industrial concentration is preferred.
6+ Years of related experience supporting automated production equipment.
Experience in technical writing to support change control and quality/compliance activities.
Setup, operation and maintenance of industrial equipment.
Electro-Mechanical Knowledge, Electrical schematics, Mechanical drawing and dimensional annotation comprehension.
Ability to understand and interface with various Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs).
Ability to work with complex industrial mechanical assembly's in an automated environment.
Ability to troubleshoot network and serial communications in equipment.
Experience working in a regulated industry (Medical, Pharmaceutical, Aerospace, or Automotive), with compliance to FDA, NHTSA, FTC, ISO or other regulatory requirements.

A regular part of the role involves staying in contact with operators, maintenance staff, and engineering personnel across different departments.
cond_0375.responsibilities:
Work in ISO level 8 cleanroom environment.
Perform set-up of processing equipment.
Monitor, audit and provide guidance to line operators and maintenance personnel — this involves daily, hands-on interaction with the people you support.
Process test runs and prepare records, charts, and graphs of results, then walk engineering through findings to help identify yield problems or test new products.

Setup, operation and maintenance of industrial equipment.

Ability to work with complex industrial mechanical assemblies in an automated environment.
Ability to troubleshoot network and serial communications in equipment.
Experience working in a regulated industry (Medical, Pharmaceutical, Aerospace, or Automotive), with compliance to FDA, NHTSA, FTC, ISO or other regulatory requirements.
